How this file was made
  The authors' files were converted to the OpenMotor format by a script written for this dataset, and
  the conversion was checked against results reported in the paper. Every trial is kept in order. Angles
  are in degrees, measured from the target, counter-clockwise positive. Participant identifiers were
  replaced by codes that are unique within this dataset: subject is one sequence of trials, person is one
